game_title: Strip And Replace – Yeti Ridge Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge, a ridge known for yetis: the ice axe ranger must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Yeti Ridge: a ridge known for yetis
core_gameplay_loop: In Yeti Ridge, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 14 consecutive correct decisions about clean_text to power up the ice axe ranger and open the ice ladder.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
